ApiKeyFilter compares the shared API key with String.equals, which is not constant time

Platform/callback API key is re-sent to any host a followed redirect points to
No cumulative per-caller limit on transaction creation

StellarRpc.hasTrustline treats any trustline entry as usable and dereferences a possibly null entries list

SEP-45 validate dereferences contract function and argument arrays without null or length checks
health() drops the 'checks' filter because the built URL is never used

RpcHelper crashes with runtime exceptions on null, empty or non-JSON-RPC bodies instead of the declared InvalidRequestException
SEP-24 deposit stores the raw request asset_issuer instead of the resolved asset issuer

findings.title: SEP-45 challenge advertises the RPC-reported network passphrase, while signing uses the configured passphrase
SEP-38 postQuote persists the quote before publishing its event, so a publish failure leaves an orphan quote

PropertyUtil.set writes any reachable bean property by dotted path with no allowlist
